title: A Small Silver Compass Found
summary: The instrument may be claimed at the market watch office.
author: Notices Desk
paragraphs: A small silver compass was found beneath the east arcade on Tuesday morning. Its case is engraved with a ring of uneven stars, and the needle is held in place by a broken catch.
The owner may apply at the market watch office between nine and four, giving a description of the inscription inside the lid. The instrument will be held there until the end of the month.
